notes.subject: fonudesen inap long nek
notes.rationale: ערות יסוד עד צואר: 'yu skruapim fonudesen inap long nek' (expose foundation to neck) tasol — samtan ol i tok 'i go Het inap long nek' (building fell to neck)

notes.subject: man bilong yu ol i kapsaitim oil long em
notes.rationale: משיחך i no nem, em i king o pris — D2: man ol i kapsaitim oil long em

notes.subject: Sela
notes.rationale: סלה i mak bilong miusik — em i stap, i no tanim

translation: Yu i go ausaut bilong helpim ol manmeri bilong yu, bilong helpim ⟨את⟩ man bilong yu ol i kapsaitim oil long em; yu brukim het bilong haus bilong man nogut, yu skruapim ⟨i⟩ fonudesen i go antap inap long nek. Sela.
